profile_text.body:
OpusClip is a video editing and repurposing tool that, according to its own site, turns long videos into short clips intended for social media distribution, and describes itself as the number one AI video clipping and editing tool. The company says it serves more than 10 million creators and allows users to publish clips to multiple social platforms in a single action.

The platform's core AI product is called ClipAnything, which the company describes as a clipping model capable of processing a broad range of video genres including vlogs, gaming, sports, interviews, and explainer videos, distinguishing it from tools the site characterizes as limited to video podcasts. ClipAnything is said to analyze visual, audio, and sentiment cues throughout a video and supports natural language prompts for targeting specific moments. OpusClip also includes an AI reframe model that resizes video for different platforms and uses object tracking to keep moving subjects centered, with a manual tracking option for additional control.

The held facts confirm OpusClip is tracked under the video generation and editing category with its primary product listed under the same name as the company. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
